title: OMIT the Action: Measuring Framing-Invariant Omission Bias under Philosophical Disagreement
reasoning: The paper introduces a benchmark to evaluate framing-invariant omission bias under moral-philosophical conflict, using a persona panel grounded in five canonical perspectives of normative ethics (utilitarianism, deontology, virtue ethics, care ethics, and contractualism) to measure the moral reasoning and judgment of LLMs.
